why_lead: UMAC new Nov27 drone-maker advisory appointment generated surge coverage across CNBC/NBC/Guardian; fresh simple political-association story, no manufactured share quote or contract.

why_smaller.title: MicroStrategy / MSTR — retail pain survives the rebound
why_smaller.selection_evidence: Yahoo Finance reported retail investors caught on the wrong side of the MicroStrategy trade, while 24/7 Wall St. addressed readers determined to buy the stock through options.[[n1501]][[n1486]] Those are fresh participation and attention accounts after the record-purchase debate. MSTR closed at USD 388.84, up +9.94% in the prior session but down -17.94% over five sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-11-27). A rebound can feel like vindication while leaving recent buyers with substantial losses. The entry price and instrument still determine the experience.

why_smaller.title: Dell / DELL — the completed selloff tests the AI bargain
why_smaller.selection_evidence: Reuters reported weak Dell and HP forecasts prompting a selloff and doubts about the PC recovery; Yahoo Finance described Dell's AI wins being overshadowed by weak guidance.[[n2175]][[n2160]] The completed reaction is now visible: DELL closed at USD 124.38, down -12.25% in the prior session and -7.15% over five sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-11-27). The dip-buying attraction is an AI-related business at a lower quotation. The operating conflict is that a promising segment must still compensate for the rest of the company's demand picture.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: the completed selloff tests the AI bargain

why_smaller.title: Reddit / RDDT — audience growth reopens the operating question
why_smaller.selection_evidence: The earlier financing story remains the relevant hook. Bloomberg.com reported Advance planning to borrow against a USD 1.2 billion Reddit stake, while Investopedia connected the report with a stock decline.[[n3999]][[n4020]] Those accounts concern a shareholder's financing, not Reddit raising operating cash. RDDT closed at USD 140.04, up 3.27% in the prior session and 20.67% over 20 sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-11-27). The rebound alone cannot answer the business or valuation questions.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: Brief shareholder-financing carryover, no new company catalyst claimed;152whitespace/160gate words.

considered_not_chosen: MSTR new actual retail-caught-out story and rebound supports side rather than another full corporate essay.
DELL completed -12.25% reaction plus fresh forecast/PC evidence updated side.
RDDT new audience-popularity evidence treated as operating reach, explicitly not investor sentiment.

DELL fresh Nov27 completed reaction and Reuters PC-recovery doubt changes Nov27 after-hours side. RDDT new Nov27 UK usage evidence changes Nov25 shareholder-borrowing side. US equity quotes use actual Nov27 session before holiday.
